column1: # Both self-propelled gun cards showed the same photograph, and it was a
# burnt-out wreck: a rusted, gutted 2S19 hulk on a plinth. Nothing about a
# recognition cue survives on it — no paint, no intact turret line, no running
# gear to read. A tester spotted it.
# Two different intact vehicles now, so the Foundations category card and the
# artillery card no longer share one picture.
#   concept-spg  a clean side profile, which is what teaches the silhouette the
#                Foundations cues describe: tall boxy hull, very large turret,
#                long barrel with a muzzle brake.
#   2s19-msta-s  a front three-quarter, where the turret detail that separates
#                this gun from the other 152 mm vehicles is legible.
